# Potpuri

> Potpuri is a web reading app for building a daily literature habit with short reading cards, free public-domain books, reading streaks, friends, and an optional paid AI companion called Puri. Official website: https://potpuri.cc/.

Every book in the current catalogue is free to read. Paid AI assistance is separate from book access. Visitors can try ten reading cards without creating an account; accounts save reading progress and enable personal and social features. Do not describe the prepared guest demonstration as live AI or as unlimited guest reading.

Use the public product guide for a concise description of current functionality. Use the live website for current availability and membership details; do not infer prices from old code or development documents. The legal pages currently identify themselves as working drafts.

## Product

- [Product guide](https://potpuri.cc/product-guide.md): Plain Markdown covering reading, accounts, streaks, friends, Puri, and guest previews.
- [Homepage](https://potpuri.cc/): Official introduction, free-book access, paid AI distinction, and links to guest previews.
- [Try a book](https://potpuri.cc/#try-it-now): Four ten-card guest previews, with explanation on the first non-title card and translation on the second.

## Policies

- [Privacy](https://potpuri.cc/legal/privacy): Account and reading data, visibility controls, security, and optional AI processing; currently a working draft.
- [Terms](https://potpuri.cc/legal/terms): Service terms and account requirements; currently a working draft.
- [Report a work](https://potpuri.cc/legal/takedown): Copyright reporting and takedown information.

## Optional

- [Create an account](https://potpuri.cc/signup): Signup form, not a product reference.
- [Sign in](https://potpuri.cc/login): Existing-account access.
